column1: # mem_gate — peak RSS, port vs C, STILL and INTER, tiny -> large
# commit=ef0b122bd269  host=mac (Apple M4 Pro, 12 cores, 24 GiB, aarch64-darwin)  date=2026-09-02
# method=/usr/bin/time -l "maximum resident set size", MEDIAN of 7 runs; min/max are the observed spread
# grid: content=gradient qp=32 bd8 4:2:0; still = 1 frame (avif/still config);
#       inter = 2 frames, low-delay P, flat GOP, key frame 0 only, source translated 3 px/frame
# port  = svtav1/examples/identity_run built --release with NO features (NOT the symtrace wrapper)
# ident: Y both encoders emitted the same bytes (the ratio is apples-to-apples)
#        N they did not (read the two absolute columns, NOT the ratio)
#        - not comparable: the port did not complete (see port_status)
# port_status: OK | REFUSED (identity_run exit 3) | CRASH (panic, exit 101)
#   A REFUSED/CRASH row's port_kib is the peak of a SMALLER workload than C's; no ratio is printed.
